exhaustive_enums.name: GatewaydError
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream matches; future operations that need extensible errors should introduce a new opaque or non-exhaustive error type without changing this contract.

exhaustive_enums.name: RuntimeReadiness
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream readiness matches; an extensible successor must be introduced additively.

exhaustive_enums.name: DomainError
exhaustive_enums.reason: This enum was already exhaustive in the public API. Keeping it exhaustive preserves downstream matches; new extensible domain operations should expose a new opaque or non-exhaustive error type.

exhaustive_enums.name: DiagnosticSeverity
exhaustive_enums.reason: panel-contracts maps every severity onto the protobuf enum. A new severity must fail to compile there rather than be silently reported as an existing one.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteMatcher
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every matcher onto the wire. A new matcher must fail to compile there rather than make a route silently unserialisable.

exhaustive_enums.name: RouteAction
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every action onto the wire. A new action must fail to compile there rather than make a route silently unserialisable.

exhaustive_enums.name: LoadBalancingPolicy
exhaustive_enums.reason: gateway-grpc encodes every policy onto the wire, and gateway-pingora maps it onto a Pingora selector. A new policy must fail to compile in both rather than fall back to an unintended one.
